response.sql: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories o LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation) SELECT observstation, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / AVG(telescope_count) OVER () AS telescope_ratio FROM station_counts ORDER BY telescope_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes with a NULL bandusagepct are still counted in telescope_count but are excluded from the average bandwidth, because AVG ignores NULLs and the request says to ignore missing values only for the average.

The average telescope count is taken across all observatories, including those with zero telescopes, and the ratio divides by that average. If no station has any telescope, the average is 0 and the division will fail in most databases.
